content:
As Amazon's fall Prime Day event officially kicks off, now is one of the best times to upgrade your AirPods. Although we haven't yet seen holiday-level discounts on Apple's latest AirPods 5 lineup, since the AirPods Pro 3 has been marked down so low, it may actually be a better choice for most people; and for those who want to experience Apple's over-ear headphones, the 2026 AirPods Max 2 is currently $120 off across all five colors.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $179 (originally $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (originally $549)

Apple has launched the new entry-level AirPods 5 with active noise cancellation at the same $129 price point, which I personally find genuinely surprising — the previous generation was selling at this price without noise cancellation. However, if you want the wireless charging case, you'll need to step up to the $149 upgraded version. That means you only need to spend an extra $30 right now to get a much more powerful and premium AirPods Pro — to me, it's a complete no-brainer.

Originally $249, it's now $70 below the sticker price, just $10 away from Amazon's all-time low — we've only recorded this price once since its launch.

In a few months we'll almost certainly see the new AirPods 5 price drop to around $100 or even lower, but based on past experience and the trajectory of the previous generation, it may not drop below the $99 mark until mid-2027. And even if it does, the AirPods Pro 3 will still offer 3 times better noise cancellation, longer battery life, a built-in heart rate sensor, all the hearing aid features, and in my view, a better fit.

All these reasons are already enough to make people choose the AirPods Pro 3 over the new 5 series, but if you're after Apple's premium over-ear headphones, then the discount on the 2026 Max 2 during the fall Prime Day is your best bet.

The current price is only $30 above Amazon's all-time low, with all five colors available, all at $120 off.

Worth noting is that since these headphones debuted earlier this year, this is only the second time we've seen them drop to this price — they've only gone lower than this once.

Of course, there are also other notable headphone deals from major brands like Sony and Bose (which can be found below), but if you ask me, nothing quite compares to a personal listening experience designed by Cupertino. If you haven't decided yet, you can also find some decent alternatives below, along with a range of eye-catching deals across the Apple ecosystem.
